theme: Glycerolipid synthesis: phosphatidic acid, DAG and TAG
core_role: The shared pathways are the core glycerolipid synthesis route (PA to DAG/MAG to TAG, plus acyl remodeling), which this theme uses as the central precursor flux that is balanced between storage triglyceride and phospholipid production by lipase and phospholipid-synthesis regulators.

theme: HDL biogenesis and cholesterol efflux
core_role: The shared pathways describe ABCA1/apoA-I-driven cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport control, framed as the cellular sterol-export step that lipidates apoA-I to assemble HDL particles (lost in Tangier disease).

theme: Sulfur amino acid and selenium compound metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are transsulfuration and sulfur amino acid catabolism together with selenium compound conversion to H2Se and methylated excretion, framed as one enzymatic machinery that processes both sulfur and selenium analogs.

theme: DNA double-strand break repair and genome stability
core_role: The shared pathways are the core DSB-repair machinery (break sensing, ATM signalling, PARP ADP-ribosylation, HR/NHEJ/MMEJ pathway choice, Fanconi interstrand cross-link repair, fork reversal), framed as genome maintenance that the additional terms extend to recombination intermediates, replication stress and checkpoints.

theme: Renin-angiotensin control of blood pressure and volume
core_role: The shared pathways are angiotensin signalling and renal sodium and urine-volume handling, framed as systemic blood pressure and volume regulation that counterbalances natriuretic-peptide cGMP signalling.

theme: M-CSF signalling in macrophage and osteoclast development
core_role: The shared pathways are CSF1/M-CSF receptor signalling driving macrophage proliferation and fusion, framed as the myeloid precursor signal that feeds osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption.

theme: MicroRNA control of fibrosis and wound-healing repair
core_role: The shared pathways combine miRNA biogenesis control with fibroblast/myofibroblast fate, TGF-beta responsiveness and ECM deposition, framed as miRNA-mediated tuning of fibrotic tissue repair.

theme: RIG-I/MDA5 RNA sensing and type I interferon induction
core_role: The shared pathways are the RLR/TLR3 to TBK1/IKKe to IRF3/IRF7 axis inducing type I interferon, framed as the interferon arm of antiviral innate immune sensing of cytosolic dsRNA.

theme: Integrated stress response and unfolded protein response
core_role: The shared pathways are eIF2alpha-kinase translational control (PERK, HRI, GCN2) and IRE1/PERK UPR branches, framed as cellular stress signalling that decides between adaptation and apoptosis, including beta-cell death.

theme: Base excision repair and DNA damage reversal
core_role: The shared pathways are glycosylase-initiated base excision repair (NEIL1/NEIL3 lesion recognition and cleavage, AP-site and single-strand break processing), framed as the excision route that also completes TDG-mediated active DNA demethylation and complements direct alkylation reversal.

theme: Insulin-stimulated glucose uptake and adiponectin sensitization
core_role: The shared pathways are adiponectin signalling and regulation of glucose import, framed as peripheral insulin sensitivity that controls GLUT4-mediated glucose uptake.

theme: Host transcriptional control of viruses and retroelements
core_role: The shared pathways are host regulation of viral transcription, DNA integration and latency (notably HCMV), framed as transcriptional silencing of integrated or foreign DNA analogous to KRAB-ZFP and HUSH repression of endogenous retroelements.

theme: LDL receptor degradation and cholesterol uptake control
core_role: The shared pathways are internalization and lysosomal degradation of LDLR/VLDLR that limit LDL clearance, framed as negative regulation of cellular cholesterol import.

theme: Actin filament severing, capping and network remodeling
core_role: The shared pathways are actin turnover regulators (severing, barbed-end capping, crosslinking, Arp2/3 inhibition, caspase cleavage of cytoskeleton), framed as cytoskeletal remodeling that powers motility and ruffle formation.

theme: Catecholamine synthesis and synaptic reuptake
core_role: The shared pathways are dopamine synthesis and catecholamine (dopamine/norepinephrine) transport and uptake, framed as presynaptic neurotransmitter clearance by DAT/NET whose defects cause parkinsonism-dystonia and orthostatic intolerance.

theme: Beta-cell insulin secretion and insulin action
core_role: The shared pathways are incretin, fatty-acid and acetylcholine control of insulin secretion plus insulin processing and clearance, framed as the secretory side of glucose homeostasis that feeds downstream insulin-receptor and glucose-uptake signalling.

theme: Negative feedback attenuation of RAS-MAPK/ERK signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are DUSP-type ERK dephosphorylation and feedback inhibition alongside oncogenic RAS/MAPK mutant signalling, framed as the brake on the RAS-ERK cascade that RAS GAPs reinforce.

theme: Anion exchange, pH control and mineralization
core_role: The shared pathways are SLC26/SLC4 anion exchangers (bicarbonate, chloride, sulfate, oxalate, iodide), carbonic anhydrase pH control and their channelopathies, framed as epithelial ion and pH handling that supports enamel mineralization.

theme: Platelet activation by GPCR agonists
core_role: The shared pathways are ADP (P2Y1/P2Y12), thrombin (PAR), thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signalling in platelets, framed as hemostatic platelet activation alongside the GPVI collagen route.

theme: GABA synthesis, vesicular loading and reuptake
core_role: The shared pathways are the GABAergic transmitter cycle (GAD synthesis, vesicular loading, GAT reuptake), framed as inhibitory synaptic transmission supported by vesicle acidification and related transporters.

theme: Spermatogenesis within the testicular niche
core_role: The shared pathways are germ cell proliferation, migration, meiotic entry and sperm mitochondrial sheath assembly, framed as germline development supported by Sertoli and Leydig somatic cells.

theme: Dendritic cell priming and T cell costimulation
core_role: The shared pathways are dendritic cell differentiation and activation plus T cell costimulation via MHC-TCR contact, framed as antigen-presenting-cell priming of CD4 T cell responses.

theme: Cardiac pacemaking and electrical conduction
core_role: The shared pathways are SA-node pacemaker depolarization (HCN channels), gap-junction electrical coupling and Purkinje-to-ventricle conduction, framed as generation and propagation of the heartbeat.

theme: Ciliary protein trafficking and ciliogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways are cargo targeting of membrane proteins into the cilium (BBSome, ARL13B-INPP5E, VxPx, myristoylated proteins), framed as the delivery side of cilium assembly that works with intraflagellar transport.

theme: Myeloid progenitor commitment and granulopoiesis
core_role: The shared pathways are transcriptional and cytokine (GM-CSF, RA, CSF) programs committing myeloid progenitors to granulocyte and mast cell lineages, framed as granulopoiesis driven further by G-CSF and RUNX1.

theme: Notch intracellular domain transcriptional signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are NOTCH2/3/4 intracellular-domain-driven target transcription and its negative regulation, framed as a cell-fate switch used in Th2 differentiation and pancreatic development.

theme: Mammary alveolar development and lactation
core_role: The shared pathways are mammary alveolar epithelial proliferation, differentiation and lactation, framed as the secretory branch of the mammary epithelial lineage hierarchy.

theme: Actin-driven lamellipodial cell migration
core_role: The shared pathways are actin polymerization, severing and capping that build lamellipodia, ruffles, podosomes and pseudopodia, framed as leading-edge protrusion for cell migration downstream of Rho GTPase-WAVE-Arp2/3.

theme: Golgi-endosome-lysosome vesicular trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways are TGN vesicle biogenesis, endosome-to-Golgi retrograde transport and lysosomal targeting, framed as the sorting machinery that routes secretory and lysosomal cargo.

theme: SLIT-ROBO and netrin axon guidance
core_role: The shared pathways are ROBO, netrin and Rho-GTPase signalling controlling axon attraction and repulsion, framed as midline and commissural axon pathfinding during nervous system wiring.

theme: Chromatin remodeling for replication and repair
core_role: The shared pathways are CHD1/2-type nucleosome assembly and disassembly, framed as chromatin access remodeling that enables DNA repair and replication-coupled chromatin assembly.

theme: Bone and tooth mineralization and phosphate regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are regulation of bone, dentin and enamel mineralization including secreted phosphoprotein phosphorylation, framed as hard-tissue mineralization governed by FGF23-Klotho and PTH phosphate signalling.

theme: Glutamate/glutamine, urea cycle and ammonia metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate, glutamine, aspartate, ornithine and arginine metabolism with urea-cycle control, framed as nitrogen handling and ammonia detoxification linked to proline and GABA metabolism.

theme: B cell activation toward plasma and memory cells
core_role: The shared pathways are B cell, memory B and plasma cell signatures and plasma cell differentiation, framed as the antibody-producing outcome of germinal centre responses helped by Tfh cells.

theme: Hormone GPCR signalling controlling insulin secretion
core_role: The shared pathways are adenylyl-cyclase-coupled hormone receptor signalling (GLP-1, glucagon, somatostatin, FFAR1, acetylcholine), framed as endocrine and nutrient GPCR control of insulin and pituitary hormone secretion.

theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and decay
core_role: The shared pathways are cleavage/polyadenylation and deadenylation/decapping decay, framed as the poly(A)-tail life cycle governing mRNA maturation and turnover, alongside histone mRNA processing.

theme: RIG-I-like receptor antiviral signalling to NF-kB and IRFs
core_role: The shared pathways are RLR sensing of cytosolic dsRNA and TRAF6/FADD-RIP1 NF-kB activation, framed as antiviral innate signalling that converges on IRF activation and is targeted by viral evasion.

theme: APOBEC3 cytidine-deaminase restriction of retroviruses
core_role: The shared pathways are APOBEC3-mediated cytidine deamination and RNA/DNA editing, framed as an antiviral restriction mechanism against HIV-1 replication that Vif counters.

theme: E2F-driven G1/S cell cycle transcription
core_role: The shared pathways are E2F target transcription and its DREAM/p107/p130 repression, framed as the proliferative cell-cycle gene program gated by RB and CDK4/6-cyclin control.

theme: Heme biosynthesis and iron homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways are heme synthesis, iron import, Fe-S cluster assembly and heme scavenging, framed as iron-heme supply for hemoglobin and oxygen-related functions.

theme: NGF/TRKA neurotrophin signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are TRKA activation and adaptor-mediated RAS, PLC-gamma, STAT3 and p38 branches, framed as neurotrophin signalling to neuronal survival and maturation via MAPK, ERK5 and CREB.

theme: Early neural plate and hindbrain patterning
core_role: The shared pathways are axis specification, neural plate border formation and hindbrain rhombomere/HOX patterning, framed as early embryonic neural patterning that leads into head and forebrain morphogenesis.

theme: Axon repulsion, collateral sprouting and regeneration
core_role: The shared pathways are semaphorin and netrin repulsion and control of axon extension and collateral sprouting, framed as growth cone guidance that also constrains axon regeneration after injury.

theme: Innate social and reproductive behaviour
core_role: The shared pathways are mating, parental, aggressive and grooming behaviours, framed as innate intraspecies social behaviour shaped by pheromone signalling and social learning.

theme: cAMP-PKA second-messenger signalling in neurons
core_role: The shared pathways are adenylyl-cyclase cAMP generation, PDE-mediated degradation and CREB activation, framed as neuromodulatory second-messenger signalling downstream of dopamine receptors and DARPP-32.

theme: Glutamate transport and recycling at synapses
core_role: The shared pathways are EAAT glutamate reuptake, vesicular glutamate loading and the astrocytic glutamate-glutamine cycle, framed as excitatory neurotransmitter clearance and recycling, paralleled by GABA reuptake.

theme: B cell activation and germinal centre responses
core_role: The shared pathways are B cell proliferation, survival, BCR signalling and differentiation, framed as the B cell side of humoral immunity culminating in germinal centre, memory and antibody responses.

theme: Motor-driven neuronal cargo transport
core_role: The shared pathways are axonal and dendritic transport of synaptic vesicles, dense-core vesicles and receptors, framed as cytoskeletal motor-driven distribution of neuronal cargo and organelles.

theme: Cation-chloride cotransport and cell volume regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and osmotic responses, framed as renal salt reabsorption and cell volume and chloride homeostasis.

theme: T cell activation and differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are TCR/ITK/PKC and IL-2/IL-7 activation modules and CD8 and gamma-delta differentiation, framed as T cell signalling through costimulation and thymic selection.
